# NOCTA

> NOCTA is Drake's premium streetwear and footwear brand featuring exclusive apparel collections, Nike collaborations, and signature sneaker designs.

NOCTA offers a curated selection of apparel, footwear, and accessories across multiple seasonal and collaborative collections. The brand is known for its partnership with Nike, producing iconic designs like the Love You Forever Air Force 1 and Hot Step sneakers, alongside its own engineered tech fleece and streetwear lines.

## Key Topics
